name: Team Topologies
description: Organizational design methodology enabling fast flow through team types, interaction modes, cognitive load management, and continuous organizational sensing.

narratives.name: Team Topologies Journey
narratives.description: The organizational transformation journey from static structures to dynamic, sensing-driven team topologies enabling fast flow.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations struggle with static hierarchical teams causing bottlenecks, dependencies, and misalignment between communication structures and system architecture per Conway's Law.
Recognition that team structure determines software architecture and value flow speed, requiring intentional organizational design using four fundamental team types and explicit interaction modes.

Platform teams reduce cognitive load through self-service capabilities while enabling teams facilitate adoption, supported by team APIs defining collaboration boundaries and platform as product thinking.
Organizational sensing enables continuous topology evolution through teams as sensors detecting when adjustments needed based on performance signals and cognitive load indicators.

Sustained fast flow becomes competitive advantage with demonstrable productivity gains, deployment reliability improvements, and mastery of architecture-organization co-evolution through sensing-driven adaptation.
